summary: Test plan for issue-9 defines 21 unit and 12 integration tests across terms config, acceptance helpers, two new API routes, the acceptance modal, upload/settings/terms pages; DB and auth are mocked since #2/#3 are unbuilt, and version-bump forced re-acceptance is covered via an independent test axis per behavior.

verification.notes: Plan-only deliverable; no tests were written or executed. Verified test-plan.md was created and every acceptance criterion in ticket.md maps to a test or an explicit 'not tested' reason.

follow_ups: Add real-DB integration tests against a live terms_acceptances table once issue #3 (Postgres schema) ships
Add automated accessibility assertions (e.g. axe) for TermsAcceptanceModal once a11y tooling is introduced to the repo
Replace mocked session identity test helper with real auth-flow tests once issue #2 (authentication) ships

open_questions.q: What exact shape will the stubbed session-identity accessor take before auth (#2) ships, so route/page tests mock the right interface?
open_questions.proposed_answer: A shared test helper mocking a single function (e.g. getCurrentTeacherId()) returning a fixed teacher id, to be swapped for the real session call once #2 lands

open_questions.q: Should the upload-route 'accepted' test assert a specific stub success response, given issue #4 (upload workflow) is unbuilt?
open_questions.proposed_answer: Assert only that the terms gate does not fire (no 403 terms_not_accepted body), not a full upload-success contract, until #4 defines the real response shape
